facts.fact: A law-firm analysis describes the National Identity Management Commission (Establishment) Act, 2026, an Act of the National Assembly, as repealing and replacing the NIMC Act No. 23 of 2007; it gives no commencement date, so the date is the document's publication date.

The analysis states the 2026 Act makes the Commission the national repository for biometric data and root certification authority for the National Public Key Infrastructure, and provides for a National Identification Number unrelated to the holder's attributes; the date is the document's publication date.
